protocol: Score held-out factory / AKWF cycles with no wrap-cliff injection: input x is the stored cycle, reference r* is the same cycle (identity target). R_blend uses alpha=0.7, SEAM_W=8, PROLONG=16, epsilon=1e-6 (locked scorer). Lower score vs no-bake means repair hurts the native wrap.
note: Honest negative result: on natural seams, leaving the cycle untouched (no-bake) outperforms every repair. Training and primary holdout use synthetic sine+cliff tiles (Section sec:dataset).

synthetic_seam_holdout.note: 14 E2 20k-step refits vs N2N on procedural sine+cliff holdout: 10/10 evaluation seeds in favor of DenoiseOpt, R_blend 0.985-0.992
